title: Template types `bootstrap.kubernetes.io/token` (and service-account tokens bound by annotation) are refused

detection.reason: read from the agent's templateType; a kubernetes.io/service-account-token template is refused only with the kubernetes.io/service-account.name annotation or an Annotations templateFrom, which the projection does not carry — the verify command checks it

quote: fix: prevent creation of specific type of secrets
remediation: The webhook (from 2.4.1) and the controller (from 2.9, on every sync) refuse an ExternalSecret whose template writes a `bootstrap.kubernetes.io/token` Secret, or a `kubernetes.io/service-account-token` Secret bound through the `kubernetes.io/service-account.name` annotation or an Annotations templateFrom. Create those Secrets another way before upgrading; the ExternalSecrets named stop syncing.
verifyCommand: kubectl get externalsecrets.external-secrets.io,clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $o | (.spec.target.template // .spec.externalSecretSpec.target.template // {}) | select(.type == "bootstrap.kubernetes.io/token" or .type == "kubernetes.io/service-account-token") | $o | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name) type=\((.spec.target.template // .spec.externalSecretSpec.target.template).type)"'  # each row writes a token-type Secret; a service-account-token one is refused only with the SA annotation or an Annotations templateFrom
